snippet.title: Hex Harmony Demo – First Look Gameplay
snippet.description:
Available now on Itch.io : https://polobuilder.itch.io/hex-harmony

Discover the free demo of Hex Harmony.
It’s a mix between puzzle gameplay and city management, all built around a hex-grid island system. Every move matters: build, manage energy, expand on your islands.

Update version : 10 February 2026
